result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculations on the transformation of the period ratio $\Lambda'/\Lambda$ of elliptic functions under unimodular substitutions $mn'-m'n=1$ with parity conditions, the values at $k^2=0,1,\pm\infty i$, and a sketch of a modular-type subdivision of a half-plane by semicircles labelled with fractions.
